privacy: Synthetic/anonymised paths and titles reproducing structural patterns found in private scanner data; source reports are NOT in this public repository.

cases.reason: Deep nested author/series/narrator/book structure with distinct chapter titles; these must be tracks, not works.
paths: Author A/Series A/Narrator A/1.0 - Novel Alpha/00 Prologue Person.mp3
Author A/Series A/Narrator A/1.0 - Novel Alpha/01 Character.mp3
Author A/Series A/Narrator A/1.0 - Novel Alpha/02 Another Character.mp3

cases.reason: Numbered names can be distinct novels. Never merge solely because they are under one folder or start with a number.
M4B can represent chapters, not just self-contained books.
paths: Author C - Novel Gamma/01 - Novel Gamma - Chapter 01.m4b
Author C - Novel Gamma/02 - Novel Gamma - Chapter 02.m4b
Author C - Novel Gamma/03 - Novel Gamma - Chapter 03.m4b

cases.reason: Multitrack book may have descriptive chapter filenames without Chapter NN in stem.
paths: Author D/Series D/Book Delta/A Strange Meeting.mp3

cases.reason: Chapter sequence may reset at each Part; Part is not a separate book.
paths: Novel Epsilon/01 - Novel Epsilon - Part One - Chapter One.mp3
Novel Epsilon/02 - Novel Epsilon - Part One - Chapter Two.mp3
Novel Epsilon/03 - Novel Epsilon - Part Two - Chapter One.mp3

cases.reason: Selected audiobook root may contain unrelated standalone media beside book directories.
A publisher/series folder contains separate issue works, even when issue numbers are sequential.
Same file name and size in two paths means only possible duplicates, not permission to delete or merge automatically.
ComicInfo absent cannot suppress a CBZ issue from the collection; cover and identity need bounded fallback.
A .cbz might fail ZIP signature validation; fail forward with a bounded error, no catalogue-wide hang.
PDFs in a comic tree include documents and magazines; never classify all PDFs as comics purely by root folder.
Most observed comic archives are RAR-based CBR. Need bounded RAR-aware metadata and cover fallback.

testingRule: Only mark a case passing when the REAL production grouping and publication implementation executes on it. This file by itself is a requirement set, not a passing test.
